explication: Lada restores mosaicked video through either a CLI or GUI: a selected video is processed frame-by-frame, with mosaic detection and restoration, then watched in real time or exported. The graph also preserves the GUI playback path and the two restoration backends. Dataset-generation and training tools are omitted as supporting workflows, not user-facing runtime stages. Evidence is limited to the README and sampled excerpts/SOURCE INDEX references; uncertain internal wiring is left out.
